#!/bin/bash
# Moves the 10M index grown with the series out of the scratchpad, to the
# benchmark volume (the user's order of 2026-11-28): a copy to another volume
# of the same container, checked file by file against the source, byte for
# byte. It removes nothing: the source is removed by hand once this says the
# copy is whole. Not while a timed measure runs.
set -u
SRC=/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-abdel-Documents-Projects-hnsw-pq-wt-posting-edge-index/e94130d1-0af4-421d-89c2-936de2c15159/scratchpad/grow10m/index
DST=/Volumes/v40bench/grow10m/index
[ -d "$SRC" ] || { echo "no source"; exit 2; }
[ -e "$DST" ] && { echo "the destination exists already"; exit 2; }
mkdir -p /Volumes/v40bench/grow10m
date "+== %Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S copy"
cp -R "$SRC" /Volumes/v40bench/grow10m/ || { echo "the copy failed"; exit 3; }
date "+== %H:%M:%S compare"
(cd "$SRC" && find . -type f -exec stat -f '%z %N' {} + | sort -k2) > /Volumes/v40bench/grow10m/source.list
(cd "$DST" && find . -type f -exec stat -f '%z %N' {} + | sort -k2) > /Volumes/v40bench/grow10m/copy.list
if ! diff -q /Volumes/v40bench/grow10m/source.list /Volumes/v40bench/grow10m/copy.list > /dev/null; then
  echo "the lists of files differ"; diff /Volumes/v40bench/grow10m/source.list /Volumes/v40bench/grow10m/copy.list | head; exit 4
fi
bad=0
while IFS= read -r line; do
  f=${line#* }
  cmp -s "$SRC/$f" "$DST/$f" || { echo "differs: $f"; bad=$((bad + 1)); }
done < /Volumes/v40bench/grow10m/source.list
date "+== %H:%M:%S done: $(wc -l < /Volumes/v40bench/grow10m/source.list | tr -d ' ') files, $bad differ"
du -sh "$DST" | awk '{print "copy: " $1}'
[ "$bad" = 0 ] && echo "THE COPY IS WHOLE"
